basis: Dentin belongs to teeth; supplied definition describes normal secondary dentin formation rather than pathological damage.
Postcholecystectomy biliary syndrome; gallbladder and bile ducts are hepatic. Urinary bladder ancestry conflicts with the definition.
Cancer originates in the lower gingiva, part of the oral cavity.
Breast carcinoma has no organ axis; hormone receptor expression does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Definition specifies a female reproductive tract tumor arising from mesonephric remnants; renal ancestry is misleading.
Giant kidney worm infection typically occupies and destroys renal tissue; ectopic sites are variable.
Purely psychiatric personality disorder without defining structural or functional organ damage on these axes.
Disorder of tendon or ligament attachment to bone; immune mediation is not established across this umbrella.
Benign tumor originating in vaginal smooth muscle; reproductive organ origin has no axis.
Adenocarcinoma originates in the lacrimal gland, part of the ocular axis.
Inherited neurodegenerative disorder ancestry supports neurologic disease; radiosensitivity alone establishes no additional organ damage.
Galactose metabolism defect defined clinically by early cataracts, reported in 30-79%; hepatic and neurologic findings are occasional.
Congenital preaxial digit malformation; diabetic embryopathy ancestry does not establish diabetes in the affected child.
Malignant giant cell tumor arises in bone; metastatic sites do not define the concept.
Progressive retinal and macular degeneration causes visual field loss and blindness.
Adenocarcinoma originates in the endocervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Inherited immunodeficiency; BCG disease is a distinct infection. Organ enlargement alone does not establish damage; osteomyelitis occurs in 2/7.
Factor IX coagulation disorder improving after puberty; chronic joint damage is not established in at least 30% of this subtype.
Developmental impairment and epilepsy define the disorder; visual impairment in 1/2 does not establish intrinsic ocular damage.
Early posterior subcapsular lens opacity; nonsyndromic cataract ancestry supports isolated ocular disease.
Nonmedullary carcinoma originates in the thyroid, an endocrine gland.
Carboxyhemoglobin impairs blood oxygen transport; cerebral toxicity is a principal target. Lasting cardiac injury is not common across all severities.
Malposition of the lacrimal punctum affects the ocular drainage apparatus.
Adenocarcinoma originates at the esophagogastric junction.
Cerebellar degeneration, sensory neuropathy and vestibular failure define CANVAS; optic atrophy reported at 30-79%. Neurogenic weakness/contractures do not establish direct muscle/joint disease.
